import os

path='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689764/attempts/e81e54f2f2424f1b8a6d71322cea1218/system/state/workspace/programs/task-49dea31c.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    # The separator is a full row or column. Compare corresponding cells
    # on its two sides; mark equal cells with 3 and retain their shared value
    # as the background.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_r = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] not in (0,)), None)
    if sep_r is not None:
        top, bottom = grid[:sep_r], grid[sep_r+1:]
        n = min(len(top), len(bottom))
        vals = [top[r][c] for r in range(n) for c in range(w) if top[r][c] == bottom[r][c]]
        bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count) if vals else 0
        return [[3 if top[r][c] == bottom[r][c] else bg for c in range(w)] for r in range(n)]
    sep_c = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if sep_c is not None:
        left, right = [row[:sep_c] for row in grid], [row[sep_c+1:] for row in grid]
        n = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
        vals = [left[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(n) if left[r][c] == right[r][c]]
        bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count) if vals else 0
        return [[3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else bg for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
    return grid
'''
